name: 4-HO-DET
summary: A rare compound first produced by Albert Hoffman, also known as ethocin. Structurally related to 4-HO-MET (metocin) and psilocin (4-HO-DMT), this drug has similar psychedelic effects but little recorded human usage. Probably similar to psilocybin mushrooms. It has potentially stimulating effects.

pharmacology.text: The drug acts as a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor among others. Ethocybin (4-PO-DET; CEY-19) and 4-AcO-DET are assumed to act as prodrugs of 4-HO-DET.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: The drug was studied in psychedelic-assisted psychotherapy by Hanscarl Leuner and colleagues in the 1960s. 4-HO-DET was encountered as a novel designer drug in 2005.

summaryZh: 4-羥二乙基色胺是一種需時適中的致幻劑和迷藥。 4-HO-DET是色胺的取代物，與脫磷酸裸蓋菇素和4-羥二異丙基色胺結構相似。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psilocin-like tryptamines, can cause nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類、類似脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（psilocin）的色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类、类似脱磷酸裸盖菇素（psilocin）的色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Albert Hofmann made it at Sandoz in the late 1950s, soon after working out the structure of psilocybin, and it was given the code name CZ-74. The German psychiatrist Hanscarl Leuner tested it in psychotherapy in the 1960s because its effects were shorter than those of psilocybin.
fact.zh: Albert Hofmann在1950年代後期於Sandoz公司合成了它，當時他剛解出裸蓋菇素的結構，這種化合物的代號是CZ-74。德國精神科醫師Hanscarl Leuner在1960年代將它用於心理治療，因為它的作用時間比裸蓋菇素短。
fact.zhHans: Albert Hofmann在1950年代后期于Sandoz公司合成了它，当时他刚解出裸盖菇素的结构，这种化合物的代号是CZ-74。德国精神科医师Hanscarl Leuner在1960年代将它用于心理治疗，因为它的作用时间比裸盖菇素短。
